data.name: Amaresh
data.long_meaning:
Ama (Immortal) + Resh (God)

The name Amaresh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words 'Ama' meaning immortal and 'Resh' meaning God. This name is given to children born with the belief that they are a manifestation of the immortal god.

In Hindu mythology, Amaresh is often referred to as the god of death, Yama, who is responsible for guiding souls to the afterlife. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer the qualities of bravery, wisdom, and compassion.
